dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: Say, if I wasn't such a bookworm, would I... *burp* be more popular in school?

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: Say, if I was as *burp* agreeable as you, would I be on better terms with everybody...?

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: And say, if I was less blunt... *burp*, mightn't I have gotten a promotion by now...?

dialogues.speaker: Mahshid
dialogues.text: Do you think that a mediocre nobody like me is a disgrace to the expectations that Lesser Lord Kusanali has of us?

dialogues.speaker: Matari
dialogues.text: Don't say that. You're doing a very important job right now.
